payload.rationale: The document is a forget/retract instruction from Xena ExpertGH targeting the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet, helium procurement contracts, and zeppelin routes — novel subjects with no prior footprint in the graph. I expanded the actor node for Xena ExpertGH, which surfaced five prior expressions all following the same forget-lifecycle pattern (establish then retract). The retraction expressions (Expr_3ForgetLifecycleRetractTarget_1/2/3), their narrative (Narrative_SpectrographCalibrationRetraction), and position (Position_KestrelwoodSpectrographCalibrationRetraction) are the direct structural analog: the passes need them to recognize this as another retraction event in the same lifecycle pattern. I also expanded the verification-side expressions and narrative (Expr_1ForgetLifecycleTarget_1/2/3, Narrative_SpectrographCalibrationVerification, Position_KestrelwoodSpectrographCalibrationVerification) because the zeppelin/helium content may need to be established before it can be forgotten, mirroring how Kestrelwood calibration was first verified then retracted. The ObservatoryCalibration strata provides the containing area, and Decision_KnowledgeMapping provides the strategic context for knowledge management decisions. The Pallasine onboarding narrative and position were deliberately not expanded — they concern a completely unrelated domain (HR onboarding checklists) with no overlap to zeppelin freight or helium procurement.
